That is, has the NDA alliance of Janata Dal United and BJP reached a situation of being completely wiped out, where they will not even get enough seats to save their face? Do you have any opinion? Please write and Tell in the comment box. Let us go to the first and big news where friends,7-8 rallies are conducted by Tajoshwi Yadav in a day and the information that has come out in the meantime is making the big political pundits lose their senses. Lets tell you that now it is being written in big newspapers that something big is going on inside Bihar and something big is going to happen in Bihar elections this time. That is you that can understand the way Bihar elections were seen earlier by connecting social equations. But now The Way Tjashui is getting public support under his leadership, big people and political pundits are also believing that something big is going to happen in Bihar. Friends, how do you see this immense support of the public? Please tell us by writing in the comment box and let's move towards another big news where pictures are going viral on social media. On one hand, Tajashwi Yadav is addressing a huge crowd in 8 rallies and the support of the people is not decreasing in any rally. The front is continuously growing and on the other side there were 3 pictures where on one side Bhupendra Yadav had posted a picture of his rally where you can see that the entire park is lying empty and here people are avoiding coming to the rally of Deputy CM Sushil Modi. Even helicopters are not coming to see. Along with this, the rally of BJP leader and Union Minister Nityanand Rai is also seen completely silent. Let's move towards another big news, where a person entered Nidish Kumar's rally. The elderly man protested in front of Nidush Kumar's stage and started shouting slogans calling Nidush Kumar a thief. After which Nidush Kumar stopped giving a speech on the stage and after that a lot of commotion was seen from the media and the policeman. And that person kept shouting slogans, calling Nidush Kumar a thief, and said that he did not do a single thing for the development of Bihar, after which the police tried to handle the matter in a hurry. But as soon as the media's attention reached the person, Nidesh Kumar started telling the media not to pay attention to him, do not point the camera at him, do not show him. You can understand what kind of condition is visible inside Bihar, where on one hand, the public is not coming in support of Nidesh Kumar and on the other hand, whoever is coming, they are also reaching the chief minister to protest and get their pending work fixed but the chief minister is completely busy giving his speech So friends what is your opinion on this whole matter Do tell us by writing in the comment box Let's move towards another big news where a video of Aanymiyara Who is trying her luck in the election from Dumranh assembly seat of Janata Daal United Is going viral on social media where she is roaming with her supporters while campaigning. We will tell them how all these schemes have fallen prey to corruption and the claims that Nitesh Kumar is making have not reached the ground. In such a situation, these claims and promises of Nidish Kumar is making have not reached the ground. In such a situation, these claims and promises of Nidish Kumar are baseless and a direct challenge has been given to the chief minister by Tajashwiri Yadav on this.
